description: The Storage Explorer enables connections to various cloud storage, providing a native file browsing experience in Power BI. This capability is particularly advantageous for business users and data analysts. It simplifies the process of sharing and collaborating on sets of files and data, eliminating the need for additional desktop installations and enhancing the overall user experience. It brings everything you need to support data analytics processes into your favorite BI tool. The Storage Explorer custom visual relies solely on the REST APIs of the specific cloud storage provider. Therefore, it is crucial to ensure that CORS rules are configured correctly. If you have any further questions or require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us.
